title: All in One Tour | Thailand, Singapore, Malaysia & Hong Kong
highlights: Stay in comfortable, well-located hotels across Thailand, Singapore, Malaysia, & Hong Kong, ensuring a relaxed and convenient experience while exploring Asia’s most vibrant cities.
Enjoy a tropical island escape to Coral Island in Pattaya, featuring speedboat transfers, powdery white sands, and turquoise waters.
Witness world-famous attractions across Southeast Asia, including Universal Studios Singapore, Singapore Night Safari, Ocean Park Hong Kong, and Madame Tussauds
Perfect for first-time travellers covering the region’s most iconic attractions, skylines, cultural landmarks, and theme parks in one well-curated journey.
overview:
About the Tour:
Embark on a 13-day Southeast Asia Highlights Tour across Thailand, Singapore, Malaysia, and Hong Kong, designed for an unforgettable blend of culture, adventure, and leisure. Begin in vibrant Bangkok and lively Pattaya, enjoying iconic shows, beaches, and thrilling water sports at Coral Island. Fly to Singapore to explore the Night Safari and experience fun at Universal Studios. Continue to Kuala Lumpur, discovering the regal Istana Negara, Petronas Twin Towers, and the lively Jalan Alor food street. Venture to Genting Highlands via scenic cable car rides and enjoy entertainment and shopping. Conclude in Hong Kong, soaking in views from Victoria Peak, exploring Madame Tussauds, and experiencing the city’s vibrant harbours and cultural landmarks. This tour perfectly blends iconic attractions, immersive experiences, and free time to create lasting memories.

know_before_you_go: Guests must carry a valid passport for the required duration and must have the necessary visa for the destinations prior to travelling.
Kindly carry soft & hard copies of flight tickets, insurance papers, and all important contact numbers handy during the trip.

Please note that cost only covers inclusions mentioned in the itinerary. International flight tickets, visa charges, travel insurance, personal expenses, and meals not listed in the itineray's inclusions are not included.
Guests must make sure that they share accurate flight details in advance for proper airport transfers arrangements.
Please note that standard check-in and check-out timings will apply in all stay destinations. Early check-in and check-out requests are subject to availability (with additional charges).
Guests must be on time for the pickups, sightseeing, and transfers. Delay in the same could lead to missing of attractions.
Kindly carry sufficient local currency or an international card. This would help greatly in expenditure on personal expenses like shopping, additional activities, etc.
Kindly act friendly with fellow guests, tour managers, hotel staff, and drivers to ensure a pleasant experience.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Bangkok | Transfer to Pattaya | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Bangkok! Upon arrival at the airport, board your transfer & get driven to Pattaya. Post check-in to your hotel, spend the rest of your day at leisure, where you can relax or explore the city on your own. You can head out and witness the iconic Alcazar Cabaret Show, renowned for its world-class choreography, extravagant costumes, and Broadway-style production. Also, you can soak in the electric vibe of Walking Street Pattaya or relax at Jomtien Beach, known for its coastal charm.

days.title: Coral Island Tour
days.desc: Begin your day with a scenic transfer to Bali Hai Pier and board a speedboat to the stunning Coral Island, a tropical paradise just off the coast. upon arrival at Tawaen Beach, famed for its powdery white sands and crystal-clear turquoise waters. Also, you can indulge in thrilling water sports like parasailing and sea walking, or simply relax by the shore, soaking in uninterrupted island views before getting driven to Pattaya for a comfortable overnight stay.

days.title: Fly to Singapore | Singapore Nigh Safari
days.desc: Check out and get driven to the airport for your flight to Singapore. Once in Singapore, check in to your hotel and relax for a while. In the evening, embark on the world-renowned Singapore Night Safari, Asia’s first nocturnal wildlife experience. Explore immersive trails and tram rides to spot over 900 animals in their naturalistic night habitats. Witness thrilling close-up encounters and captivating cultural shows, and enjoy an unforgettable journey into the world of nocturnal wildlife.

days.title: Day Trip to Universal Studios
days.desc: Today, get ready to spend a full day at Universal Studios Singapore, where thrilling rides, immersive zones, and blockbuster movie-themed attractions bring your favorite films to life. Once there, you can enjoy adrenaline-pumping roller coasters to interactive shows and character meet-and-greets; the park offers entertainment for all ages. Dive into themed worlds like Hollywood, Far Far Away, and Jurassic Park, creating a fun-filled adventure and unforgettable memories for the entire family.

Spend the rest of the day at leisure, where you can explore Merdeka Square, famed for its historic charm and colonial architecture or stroll along Jalan Alor to savor bustling night market vibes and local delicacies. Also, you can enjoy interactive creativity at the Illusion 3D Art Museum Kuala Lumpur for a fun and memorable experience.

days.title: Kuala Lumpur City Tour | Visit to Petronas Twin Tower
days.desc: Today, embark on an amazing Kuala Lumpur city tour to discover the city’s iconic landmarks. Begin at Istana Negara, the royal palace showcasing Malaysia’s regal heritage, followed by Tugu Negara, the National Monument honoring the nation’s heroes. Stroll through Merdeka Square with its colonial-era charm, and conclude at the world-famous Petronas Twin Towers, ideal for breathtaking photos and panoramic city views. Later, get driven to your hotel after a day of enriching sightseeing.

days.title: Kuala Lumpur | Trip to Genting Highlands & Batu Caves
days.desc: In the morning, get driven to explore the Batu Caves, famed for its towering Lord Murugan statue and awe-inspiring limestone caves. Continue uphill to the Awana Skyway and enjoy a scenic cable car ride to Genting Highlands, offering panoramic views of misty hills and lush forests. Upon arrival, explore attractions like SkyAvenue Mall, entertainment zones, and leisure spots at your own pace. After a fun-filled day, get driven to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.desc: After check-out, get driven to your hotel in Hong Kong. Upon your arrival, check in to your hotel and spend the rest of your day at leisure. You can head to soak in the city’s vibrant atmosphere at your own pace—stroll through nearby streets, explore local cafés, or simply enjoy the hotel amenities as you prepare for the exciting experiences ahead in this dynamic city.

days.title: Visit to Madame Tussauds
days.desc: Today, get ready and visit the iconic Madame Tussauds Hong Kong, where lifelike wax figures of global celebrities, historical icons, and local stars await. Once there, enjoy interactive exhibits, pose with your favorite personalities, and capture memorable photos in themed zones that bring entertainment, history, and pop culture to life. This immersive experience blends fun and creativity, making it a must-visit attraction for all ages in the heart of Hong Kong. Later, get driven to the hotel.

days.title: Macau City Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, enjoy a scenic drive to Macau and embark on a full-day sightseeing tour. Start with Macau Tower, offering breathtaking panoramic views of the city skyline. Explore the Ruins of St. Paul’s, a stunning fusion of European Renaissance and Asian architectural motifs. Visit Na Tcha Temple, believed to protect the city from epidemics, the symbolic Lotus Statue, and the historic Walls of Macau, showcasing the city’s colonial-era defenses. Later, get driven to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day Trip to Ocean Park
days.desc: Today, embark on a full day of excitement at Ocean Park Hong Kong, a perfect blend of thrills, wildlife, and scenic beauty. Explore its seven themed zones, from Polar Adventure to Whiskers Harbour, and enjoy over 40 attractions, including adrenaline-pumping rides like Flying Swing. Meet adorable dolphins and giant pandas, and don’t miss the panoramic cable car ride offering stunning views of the park. Later, get driven to your hotel for a relaxing overnight stay.
